headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: White House press secretary Katie Zacharia fired 5 days into job.
Congress steps up agitation for removal of Chief Election Commissioner.
Why afraid of impartial probe: Former Punjab Minister Sodhi hits back at AAP over CBI case.
BESS policy and portal to be launched soon, says Energy Resources Minister Nirmal Kumar.
bullets_ur: Katie Zacharia, jo White House ki press secretary thi, bas 5 din mein job se hata di gayi.
Congress ne Chief Election Commissioner ko hatane ke liye ehtijaj tez kar diya
Impartial tehqeeq se kyun dartay hain: Sabiq Punjab Minister Sodhi ka CBI case par AAP par palatwar.
BESS niyam aur portal jaldi shuru ho jaye ga, kehti hai wazir-e-ataqat Nirmal Kumar.
